gloss: reply postcard; pre-addressed reply card (esp. of an ōfuku-hagaki)

definitions.gloss: reply postcard; pre-addressed reply card (esp. of an ōfuku-hagaki)
definitions.explanation: The reply half of an {往復|おうふく}はがき (round-trip postcard), or any pre-addressed postcard included with an invitation, survey, or business correspondence so that the recipient can write a reply and mail it back. Frequently used for wedding invitations, alumni-association notices, and formal business RSVPs.

examples.japanese: {返信|へんしん}はがき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I sent off the reply postcard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{招待状|しょうたいじょう}→招待状：14769_shoutaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{返信|へんしん}はがき⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同封|どうふう}→同封：16367_doufuu⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A reply postcard was enclosed with the wedding invitation.

examples.japanese: {返信|へんしん}はがき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧・⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{送|おく}り{返|かえ}して→送り返す：14975_okurikaesu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be sure to send back the reply postcard whether you are attending or not.

examples.japanese: {返信|へんしん}はがき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宛名|あてな}→宛名：03995_atena⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「{行|ゆき}」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二重線|にじゅうせん}→二重線：10288_nijuusen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消|け}し→消す：00528_kesu⟧、「⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}す→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{礼儀|れいぎ}→礼儀：03780_reigi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is considered proper etiquette to cross out the {行|ゆき} on the address of the reply postcard and rewrite it as {様|さま}.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧ (reply; written response) and ⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (postcard, often written {葉書|はがき}). The everyday spelling mixes kanji and hiragana, as the postcard word is most commonly written in hiragana on consumer products.

USAGE:
Used both for the back half of a Japan Post ⟦{往復|おうふく}→往復：04111_oufuku⟧⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (a single perforated postcard with two halves: outgoing and reply) and, by extension, for any reply card included in formal mail. Etiquette around how to fill it out is well known: the sender's '{行|ゆき}' or '{宛|あて}' on the address is replaced with '⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧'; honorific prefixes like {御|ご}/お in front of the recipient's words ({御出席|ごしゅっせき}, {御芳名|ごほうめい}) are crossed out before writing one's own response. Frequently encountered with weddings, funerals, alumni events, and PTA notices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返信|へんしん}はがき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send back the reply postcard
- {返信|へんしん}はがき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to fill out the reply postcard
- {返信|へんしん}はがき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宛名|あてな}→宛名：03995_atena⟧: the address printed on the reply postcard
- {返信|へんしん}はがき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧: how to fill out a reply postcard
